Frequently Asked Questions

Kolkata property questions answered

Useful answers for comparing projects and planning your next step.

Which commercial project does Ruchi Realty offer in Kolkata?+

Active Business Park is Ruchi Realty's listed commercial development in Kolkata, offering office, retail and other commercial spaces.

How can I check commercial space sizes and availability?+

Open the Active Business Park project page or submit the enquiry form with your preferred space type and approximate requirement. The team will share current options.

How can I check current project prices and availability in Kolkata?+

Use the enquiry form on this page or open the relevant project page. The Ruchi Realty team will share the latest price, inventory, configuration and site-visit information for Kolkata.

Can I schedule a Ruchi Realty site visit in Kolkata online?+

Yes. Submit the enquiry form with your preferred project and contact details, and the relevant team will coordinate a suitable site-visit time.

Where can I find RERA details for a project?+

Open the individual project page to view the RERA registration number when applicable and available. Buyers should also verify the details on the relevant state RERA portal.
